age: Pancreata from 12-week-old male C57BL/6NJR mice (Janvier, Saint Berthewin Cedex, France) or 12-week-old male C57BL/6NTAC mice (Taconic, Lille Skensved, Denmark) were inflated with Liberase (Roche, Hvidovre, Denmark), excised and incubated at 37 °C to allow digestion.
cell_type: The aim of this study was to investigate the mechanism by which BMP-2 induces beta cell dysfunction and loss of cell maturity.
disease_state: Insufficient insulin secretion is a hallmark of type 2 diabetes and has been attributed to beta cell identity loss characterized by decreased expression of several key beta cell genes.
